sent_to_model:
kristen my boss at the hardware store wants my side of saturday in writing. yes it was my popcorn, no point pretending. need to answer her email below. own up to it, offer to cover the 175 and i really dont want to lose saturdays. shes ticked so i cant be a wiseguy the whole way thru but she knows me, a little ribbing at myself is ok. i type lousy so fix it up but dont make me sound like a lawyer tell her she can take it from my check or i bring cash.

- sat nov 7 about 10:40, put popcorn in break room micro, hit the popcorn button, walked out front
- guy needed a shear pin for his snowblower, took longer then i thought, maybe 6 7 min
- store cleared out about 25 min, engine from up on hertel came, no damage, just smoke + stink
- the september alarm was NOT me, that was the sensor in the paint aisle
- one of the guys on the engine was Mikey Szymanski, i broke him in as a probie back in 03. he will never let me forget this
- 31 yrs on the job and i get my first alarm as a civilian over a bag of butter popcorn
- wife said the van smelled like a burnt movie theater
- its on me, not the microwave
- Hendersons will be back, they always are, but i feel bad
- pay the 175 out of my check or i bring cash, her call
- keep my saturday shifts, i like the weekend crowd + need the hours for heating oil
- buy denise her coffee
- not too long, she reads these on her phone

Thread: Saturday alarm
(I'm Walt Brzezinski here. I'm replying to Kristen Wojcik <kristen@delaneyshardware.example>'s message of 2026-11-09T08:05:00.)

---

From: Kristen Wojcik <kristen@delaneyshardware.example> | 2026-11-07T16:12:00
All,

As most of you know we had the fire alarm go off this morning and had to clear the store. Everybody got out fine which is the main thing. Thank you to whoever grabbed the cash drawer.

Effective immediately, no more microwave popcorn in the break room. I'm serious. I don't care what brand.

Kristen

---

From: Denise Pratt <denise@delaneyshardware.example> | 2026-11-07T16:40:00
I grabbed the drawer! Also somebody owes me a coffee, I was standing out there by the propane cage with no coat for 20 min lol. Not naming names WALT

---

[the message I'm replying to] From: Kristen Wojcik <kristen@delaneyshardware.example> | 2026-11-09T08:05:00
Walt,

Taking this off the group thread. I need your account of what happened Saturday in writing by Wednesday. Northpoint Alarm billed us $175 for the dispatch and Gary wants it on file for the insurance people. This is our second alarm since September and he is not happy, he asked me whether we need to rethink the weekend schedule.

I know it was an accident. But we had a store full of customers out in the lot in 30 degree weather, and the Hendersons left a full cart at the register and didn't come back. Please just give me the straight story.

Kristen

(About me: retired firefighter, 68, Buffalo, New York. Length: it should come to roughly 250-400 words.)

must_cover: Explains the popcorn incident and accepts responsibility.
Offers to pay the full dispatch bill and lets Kristen choose between payroll deduction and cash.
Says he will buy Denise her coffee.
